svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 50 mm length of 10 x 6 mm steel flat bar; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm and tap M4, 6 mm deep (through), 10 mm from each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end on the centre line (30 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint or zinc spray it against rust.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies flat on the tray across the centre line, its lower

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge 140 mm above the middle of the tray (toward the head

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube); two M4 countersunk screws up from under the tray.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pack's spring latch drops in behind it: with the pack

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the end stop the latch sits 3 mm short of the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it stands 6 mm proud of the tray and is square across.
